top_tweets.text:
Galaxy Fam 👋

What if One UI adopted a frosted glass design? 👀

I've been working on a few concepts and personally think it gives One UI a much more modern and premium look.

Would you like Samsung to explore this design language? 👇

I need your support by commenting on this https://t.co/hHgohFvYlB
top_tweets.author: tarunvats33
top_tweets.name: Tarun Vats
top_tweets.summary_zh: 設計師提出為 Samsung One UI 採用毛玻璃設計語言的概念，認為這能讓介面更現代與高級。展示了 UI 設計趨勢如何影響使用者對產品質感的感知。

top_tweets.text: here's Portland's new terminal and Xi'an's railway station side by side. the wood and light is welcoming. the futurist design feels hostile https://t.co/2alfNeIq0r
top_tweets.author: quorumcaller
top_tweets.name: quorumcall
top_tweets.summary_zh: 將波特蘭新航廈的木質溫暖設計與西安車站的未來主義風格並列比較，指出前者親切、後者疏離。提醒設計師材質與風格如何影響空間的情感氛圍。

top_tweets.text: no disrespect but this is mediocre. 0 artistic vision, 0 game design knowledge, 0 sauce. removing automation isn't good if you can't understand why it's there in the first place. the level design is barely changed to accommodate the lack of automation, so the levels feel lifeless
top_tweets.author: sonicbuni
top_tweets.name: maurice
top_tweets.summary_zh: 批評某款遊戲移除自動化功能卻未調整關卡設計，導致體驗空洞。強調產品設計中「理解功能存在原因」比單純移除功能更重要，需要整體思考。

top_tweets.text:
The bee hotel from the garden center probably isn't actually helping bees. It might even be hurting them. But a well-designed one actually can work.

Scott MacIvor, a researcher at the University of Toronto, set up 200 bee hotels across the city and monitored them for three https://t.co/wPQtIPr5E7
top_tweets.author: giveashitnature
top_tweets.name: Give A Shit About Nature
top_tweets.summary_zh: 多倫多大學研究發現，市售蜜蜂旅館設計不當可能傷害蜜蜂，但精心設計的確實有效。提醒產品設計需基於實證研究，而非僅滿足表面需求或行銷目的。
